slates.name: Oregon Working Families Party
slates.note: Avalos, Routh and Ender endorsed 2024-07-23; Dunphy added in the second round, 2024-09-25 (https://workingfamilies.org/2024/09/oregon-working-families-party-endorses-second-round-of-portland-city-council-candidates/).

slates.name: Northwest Oregon Labor Council
slates.note: Endorsed in late May / June 2024. The labor PAC Working for a Better Portland promoted the council's slate from October 15.

slates.name: Portland Police Association
slates.note: The union did not publish its list; Willamette Week reported Hayes was its only District 1 endorsement as of July 2024.

slates.name: United for Portland (Spotlight)
slates.note: Business-backed coalition (Portland Metro Chamber is a member). Spotlight = candidates it asked voters to rank above its other Green Light picks.

slates.name: United for Portland (Green Light, including Spotlight)
Portland Metro Chamber
slates.note: Ranked 1, 2, 3; told voters to rank only these three.

slates.name: Willamette Week (media)
slates.note: Newspaper endorsement, ranked 1 to 6; the last three described as backups.

slates.name: The Oregonian editorial board (media)
slates.note: Members from a secondary source (see source title). The Portland Metro Chamber page confirms that 11 of the Oregonian's 12 picks were United for Portland endorsees, the exception being in District 1, which fits Avalos.

slates.name: Avalos and Routh
slates.note: Held joint house parties and handed out each other's fliers.

notes: Multnomah County cast vote record cvr-councilor-district-1.csv. Ballot allowed 6 ranks. Cleanup follows Portland City Code 2.08 (see data/portland/README.md). Ballots with an overvote: 1453; with a skipped rank: 1206; with a repeated candidate: 714; remade ballots: 2188. Blank: 11558 with no marks (estimated from precinct styles), 700 with only overvoted ranks. 'Uncertified Write In' stands for all write-ins for people not on the City's certified write-in list, combined; the official count treats it as one candidate. Official winners from the final RCTab summary official/city-of-portland-councilor-district-1.json (Multnomah County Elections, certified December 2, 2024). Our first-choice totals differ from the official first round by 10 votes in all; see checks.json.
